technical_summary: Pilot workload: chat-first assistant + periodic embeddings for semantic search; some reranking on results page.
Trial window (2 weeks) results: ~18k total API requests, avg QPS ~0.6, observed peak QPS 7 during business hours; 95th latency for streaming tokens ~220ms (hosted).
Observed token profile during trial: chat requests avg 60 prompt tokens + 220 response tokens = ~280 tokens/request; embeddings avg 512 tokens per call (sparse), reranking small (~32 tokens).
Trial token mix (by request count): chat 72%, embeddings 18%, reranking 10%; by token volume chat ~80% of tokens.
Production projection (12-mo ramp): target steady-state QPS 8, peak QPS 25, target concurrency during peak ~40-60, expected monthly token volume ~140M-200M tokens depending on adoption.
Desired SLOs: p95 latency <300ms token-generation for chat, tail latency mitigation via dedicated capacity and caching.
Routing needs: want model routing by region (NA/EU) and fallback to smaller quantized variants on cost-sensitive tiers.
Caching: interested in prefix/KV caching to reduce token load on repeated prompts (support macros + embeddings cache).
poc_results: Hosted trial validated SDK integration + streaming; product team satisfied with end-to-end response quality.
Performance: hosted peak handled without error; some rate-limit events reported during a 30-minute burst (RINF-4521).
Cost estimate from trial: current hosted spend extrapolated to production would be ~3-4x their preferred OPEX; motivates committed Dedicated pricing discussion.
Security: SOC2 doc accepted internally; SSO/SAML integration in scope but needs engineering time (2-3 sprints).
POC ask: Redwood to provide sizing recommendation (GPU count or qps baseline) and committed pricing tiers for 12/24 month terms.
capacity_forecast_notes: Customer asked for capacity recommendation: starting point = 1 Dedicated pool with burstable nodes to cover peak 25 QPS and concurrency 60; SE suggests 4 x A40-equivalent GPUs as baseline for target token mix (subject to kernel/quantization).
Traffic forecast assumptions provided to customer: 3x growth next 6 months, monthly token estimate ~140M -> 420M tokens at scale; recommend staged commit (3-month eval -> 12-month baseline commit).
Batching and caching expected to reduce effective token processing by 18-25% based on prompt reuse and embeddings cache; include that in committed capacity plan.
Backup plan: fallback to hosted public pool for unexpected bursts; routing policy to prefer Dedicated but overflow to Hosted (policy + cost cap).
